options.name: add_sids
options.description: Add SIDs for existing users and groups. Requires IPA 4.9.8+ and SID generation to be activated.

options.name: ca_renewal_master_server
options.description: Renewal master for IPA certificate authority.

options.name: configstring
options.description: Set extra hashes to generate in password plug-in

options.name: defaultgroup
options.description: Set the default group for new users

options.name: defaultshell
options.description: Set the default shell for new users

options.name: domain_resolution_order
options.description: set list of domains used for short name qualification

options.name: emaildomain
options.description: Set the default e-mail domain

options.name: enable_migration
options.description: Enable migration mode

options.name: enable_sid
options.description: New users and groups automatically get a SID assigned. Cannot be deactivated once activated. Requires IPA 4.9.8+.

options.name: groupobjectclasses
options.description: Set default group objectclasses (comma-separated list)

options.name: groupsearch
options.description: Set comma-separated list of fields to search for group search

options.name: homedirectory
options.description: Set the default location of home directories

options.name: ipaadmin_password
options.description: The admin password.

options.name: ipaadmin_principal
options.description: The admin principal.

options.name: ipaapi_context
options.description:
The context in which the module will execute. Executing in a
server context is preferred. If not provided context will be
determined by the execution environment.

options.name: ipaapi_ldap_cache
options.description: Use LDAP cache for IPA connection.

options.name: maxhostname
options.description: Set the maximum hostname length between 64-255

options.name: maxusername
options.description: Set the maximum username length between 1-255

options.name: netbios_name
options.description: NetBIOS name of the IPA domain. Requires IPA 4.9.8+ and SID generation to be activated.

options.name: pac_type
options.description: set default types of PAC supported for services

options.name: pwdexpnotify
options.description: Set number of days's notice of impending password expiration values 0 to 2147483647

options.name: searchrecordslimit
options.description: Set maximum number of records to search values -1 to 2147483647 (-1 or 0 is unlimited)

options.name: searchtimelimit
options.description: Set maximum amount of time (seconds) for a search values -1 to 2147483647 (-1 or 0 is unlimited)

options.name: selinuxusermapdefault
options.description: Set default SELinux user when no match found in map rule

options.name: selinuxusermaporder
options.description: Set order in increasing priority of SELinux users

options.name: user_auth_type
options.description: set default types of supported user authentication

options.name: userobjectclasses
options.description: Set default user objectclasses (comma-separated list)

options.name: usersearch
options.description: Set comma-separated list of fields to search for user search
